attributes.board_name: Montana Board of Occupational Therapy Practice (Department of Labor and Industry)

rules.accepted_credit_types: CE germane to OT; any CE offered or approved by MOTA, AOTA, ASHT, NBCOT or the American Journal of Occupational Therapy is accepted. College courses (1 semester credit = 15, 1 quarter credit = 10 contact hours); teaching/presenting (2 h per hour, once per topic); return-to-practice or specialty apprenticeships (10 h per 40-hour week, no limit); reading books/articles (1 h each, max 4 per year) and other activities listed in the rule.
rules.new_licensee_rule: Not required until the licensee's first full year of licensure.
rules.alternatives: Maintaining current NBCOT certification fulfils the CE requirement.
rules.audit_note: Affirm the recurring CE duty at renewal; the board may randomly audit up to 50% of renewed licensees. Keep records and produce them on request.
rules.notes: Annual renewal; licenses expire June 15. Pending change: MAR Notice 2026-148 (HB 438, 2025) proposes moving OT into a consolidated Board of Physical, Rehabilitative, and Developmental Health Care Professionals with a single CE rule (24.119.2101) that keeps 10 hours per year for occupational therapists and NBCOT certification as an alternative, with audits by statistical sampling.
